narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves to entertain a gaming audience by critiquing and satirizing a specific 'item-swapping' technique in Arena of Valor. The creator highlights the absurdity of changing gear in the middle of a battle and jokes about how slow it looks when an interruption (the iOS notification) occurs, using humor and mimicry to connect with his viewers.
